answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must lock stake subject to cryptographic stake burning with superlinear cost scaling $C(n) = k \cdot n^2$. A forged identity cannot whisper consensus votes cheaply; forging $n$ identities drives expected returns below the profitability nadir. Rather than spamming network bandwidth like an automated sonnet, an attacker faces quadratic resource depletion per validation slot.
